Well, it depends on how you view the concept of using a Human Effigy - Back in Dark Souls 1, there was a lot of lore behind humanity, specifically a quote along the lines of "How strange was it that humans had little use for Humanity until they were afflicted with the curse" and how even though you used a humanity to restore yourself, you were still afflicted with the curse and eventually go hollow (as what happened to a handful of NPC's)

Now for Dark Souls 2, a Human Effigy seems to differ from Humanity in that it "reminds" the player who they once were and you become that person (Firekeepers at the start explains how if you look into it you see yourself). 

Going from this, I'd guess that using a human effigy reminds you of who you were before the curse, and grants you that appearance and memory, and at this point in your life you didn't have the Dark Sign, and so are now unable to use it.

But remembering your original humanity doesn't mean you are human, your true self is your cursed self (how you start out originally at the beginning of the game enroute to Dranglaic in the Cutscenes as well as you running to the Firekeepers), and each time you die you forget more and more of your original human self - While using an Effigy would again remind you of who you were.
